title: The compactly supported direct image of Weil complexes has a right adjoint
statement:
Let $k_0$ be a finite field, $\ell$ a prime different from $\operatorname{char}k_0$, and $\Omega=\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$ (Lean `PadicAlgCl ℓ`). For a finite-type $k_0$-scheme $T_0$, let $\mathrm{WC}_{\mathrm{der}}(T_0)$ be the actual full subcategory of the derived category of pro-etale Weil module sheaves whose cohomology is bounded and constructible [def-sf-native-weil-derived-framework]; in Lean this is `AlgebraicGeometry.WeilComplex k₀ ℓ T₀`. Let $f_0:X_0\to Y_0$ be separated, quasi-compact and locally of finite type over $k_0$, where $Y_0$ is quasi-compact, quasi-separated and locally of finite type over $k_0$, and $X_0$ is quasi-compact and locally of finite type over $k_0$. Then the actual chosen-compactification direct image with compact support
$$Rf_{0!}^{\mathrm{der}}:\mathrm{WC}_{\mathrm{der}}(X_0)\longrightarrow\mathrm{WC}_{\mathrm{der}}(Y_0)$$
has a right adjoint. Denote that right adjoint by $Rf_0^{!,\mathrm{der}}$, the exceptional inverse image on these derived Weil complexes. Thus $Rf_{0!}^{\mathrm{der}}\dashv Rf_0^{!,\mathrm{der}}$ on exactly the categories above. In Lean the existence is `AlgebraicGeometry.WeilComplex.HasUpperShriek k₀ ℓ f₀`, and the named functor is `AlgebraicGeometry.WeilComplex.upperShriek f₀`.

proof.text: Restrict the existing hull adjunction along iX and iY using Mathlib Adjunction.restrictFullyFaithful. Both comparison isomorphisms are identity isomorphisms because all restrictions preserve the original ambient objects and morphisms definitionally. Its left restriction is precisely the unchanged derivedLowerShriek definition, with the identical chosen compactification. The restricted adjunction gives IsLeftAdjoint, hence the unchanged HasUpperShriek conclusion.

The delivery answers the released 2026-10-22 re-split note (keep_plan, at least 3 new nodes, assembly at most 3000 characters). Live and side-live still hold the old 9-step Q06 proof and none of the new ids exists there, so nothing supersedes it. The item statement, stmt_deps and maintainer fields are byte-identical to live, and all 9 old step texts are kept verbatim in the report.

Step mapping: old steps 2-4 became lem-sf-native-weil-derived-induction-comparison: Grothendieck hearts, U preserves K-injectives (08BJ), beta : U_Y F_W ≅ F U_X, and kappa with the summand formula c_n then F(iota_n), invertible on L_X through the sums node. Old steps 5-6 became lem-sf-native-weil-localizing-brown-adjoints: L_W = U^{-1}(L_T) by the inclusions and the cyclic triangle, F_W preserves coproducts through beta and conservativity, and the hypotheses of the solution-set, representability, idempotent and assembly nodes are met. Old steps 1 and 7 became lem-sf-native-geometric-brown-constructible-comparison: J-transported G_c with the explicit counit, and t : G_c ≅ G|_C because the cone is right-orthogonal to C_X and therefore to Loc(C_X). The node sizes are comparable (3.2-3.6k characters), and none restates the item. Old steps 8-9 (five Hom bijections, Yoneda, full-subcategory restriction) stay in the item as a 2403-character assembly; I checked every domain.

Edge cases tested: empty X, f = id, P = id, negative powers, and the Jordan Frobenius block (D(W) is never identified with fixed pairs). Hypotheses and the native B_T coefficients are unchanged, and the target is not weakened. No SGA.

Batch-5: all four flagged citations (constructible-realization twice, compact-support-realization, constructible-exceptional-adjunction-coefficients) were already in the base item's proof_deps, so the closure is unchanged. The nodes they reach (lem-trf-counit-realization-substitution, lem-pd-section-derived-pushpull-normalization, lem-pod-derived-exact-square-composition) are generic realization and derived-pasting coherences, outside the trace-formula and Poincare-duality assumptions.
